## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Cuneo, Italy. It starts at Via De Rege Thesauro, 5.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Chivalry isn't dead, it's just enjoying retirement in Manta Castle. Nestled in the peaceful foothills of the Cottian Alps, the frescoed halls of this grand Italian manor are just as breathtaking as the scenery around it – and that's saying something!
>
> Put on your most genteel expression and wander the castle like a noble of old. Discover remarkable artworks of knights and maidens in stunning large-scale murals and ceiling frescoes. Explore the kitchens, gardens, and more!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.44. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 30 ratings and 14 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
